hero.title: Food-grade HDPE coating of shafts and rollers
hero.subtitle: We robot-print food-grade HDPE directly onto your shaft or roller and mill the layer to size in the same cell. Up to Ø600 × 3500 mm, new or as a recoat, delivered in 3 weeks.
hero.image_alt: Blue food-grade HDPE coating on a roller, milled to size

problem.heading: Worn rollers cost you downtime
items: Rollers and shafts in food production wear, get damaged, or fall short of hygiene requirements on contact surfaces.
New rollers in special materials often have long lead times, especially for small quantities or non-standard sizes.
Conventional coatings need a mould or casting tool, so they rarely pay off for one roller or a small series.
As a result, worn shafts are often replaced instead of repaired.

solution.heading: Food-grade HDPE, printed on your shaft or roller
solution.body: RoBuPRINT prints food-grade HDPE with a robot arm directly onto a metal or plastic core. In the same cell we mill the layer to a dimensionally accurate running surface, smooth or with a milled pattern. No mould, no casting tool: even a single piece or a small series is feasible. The same process works for recoating a worn roller.

items.v: We print food-grade HDPE (blue), odour- and taste-neutral and hygienically cleanable.
No casting tool or die; also for unique sizes and small series.
A new layer on your existing shaft or roller.
Tolerance up to ±0.2 mm, smooth or patterned (e.g. for dough rollers, grip or transport).
Low friction, low weight, low moisture absorption and hygienic to clean.
Part of Kuypers Kunststoftechniek, with in-house material knowledge and supply.

uses.heading: For rollers and shafts in the food industry
uses.note: Also for conveyor systems and internal transport, and for industrial environments in HDPE or PP without a food-grade requirement. We work for, among others, the bakery industry.

example.heading: Example: food-grade rollers for the food industry
example.body: Plastic cladding on metal or plastic shafts, smooth or with a milled-in pattern, in food-grade blue HDPE. Client: food industry.
example.alt_2: Food-grade blue HDPE roller, detail of the running surface

items.a: Up to Ø600 mm and 3500 mm in length. Larger or bulkier: ask us and we will assess it separately.
Lead time is 3 weeks. We process approx. 20 shafts per week.

items.q: Can a worn roller be recoated?
items.a: Yes. We apply a new layer to your existing shaft or roller; an existing plastic core can also be recoated.

items.q: Is the material suitable for food contact?
items.a: We use food-grade HDPE. If your process has a specific requirement, mention it in your request and we will include it in our assessment.
Both. A pattern can be printed directly or milled in.

items.q: Do you work with small quantities?
items.a: Yes, even a single piece, because no mould is needed.

items.q: What do I need for a quote?
items.a: Diameter, length, quantity, desired layer thickness (or "don't know") and preferably a photo or drawing.

closing.heading: A shaft or roller to coat?
closing.body: Send diameter, length and a photo. You will receive a first estimate within 2 working days.
